About Jitto

Bonjour! I’m Jitto, a Paris-based Tamil content creator, storyteller and digital explorer, bringing the vibrant essence of France to a global audience. Originally from Tamil Nadu, India, my journey in Paris began with a passion for documenting life abroad, cultural experiences and travel adventures.

Through Jitto Vibes, I blend authentic lifestyle vlogs, European travel stories and practical student-abroad guides, connecting cultures with energy, positivity and a “Good Vibes Only” spirit. Whether it’s capturing the magic of Parisian streets, exploring hidden gems across Europe, or helping aspiring students navigate their dreams in France, my goal is to inspire, entertain and build a meaningful community.

  • Based inParis, France
  • Originally fromTamil Nadu, India
  • CreatesVlogs, travel stories, student guides, digital marketing
  • LanguagesEnglish, French, Tamil
